snapshot.scope: Visible and retryable Local RAG degradation from Settings enable through durable index rebuild, Home lexical fallback and restart recovery.

reviewers.task: Review enabled Local RAG degradation, Job retry and restart recovery
reviewers.independence: Planning reviews the API and Job lifecycle boundary; Development supplies separate engine, retrieval, registrar and durable restart/retry evidence.

dimensions.summary: Settings Enable schedules the existing durable rebuild owner; Home retains bounded lexical evidence and visibly marks an unhealthy enabled adapter.
Schema, retrieval engine, Main registrar, Job executor and existing Home warning agree on one local_rag_unavailable degraded state.
Focused evidence covers optional-disabled health, enabled adapter failure, lexical projection, durable retry and same-Job restart adoption without claiming all E1.18 adapter parity.
Existing Local Semantic, Local RAG and index_rebuild owners remain authoritative; no parallel retry store, renderer runtime assumption or new Job class is introduced.
Two existing owner paragraphs bind the behavior without a new design document, status promotion or duplicated runtime contract.
